shortDescription: Embraer is partnering with Northrop Grumman to develop a specialized refueling system for potential local production of its military model KC-390. "Embraer Mulls New Aircraft Lines as Core Jet Business Booms — Interview," at 3:24 p.m. ET, incorrectly said the partnership was with L3Harris.
